text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, good morning! I really 
enjoyed my time off!
choice_data_list: That's great! Did you go anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Playing tennis with friends, 
watching movies, eating sweets at cute 
cafes...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she got her hair and tail 
styled at the salon, then headed to the 
sporting goods store to buy a new bottle 
and towel!
choice_data_list: We sure went out a lot...!
We sure went out a lot, didn't we...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm pretty much always like this. 
Going out here and there is the best way 
for me to refresh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was such an active holiday that one 
might wonder if she actually got any rest, 
but her complexion was glowing. It seemed 
she had fully refreshed herself in both 
body and mind.
